about: Known-good and known-bad solutions for the AI approach evaluation. Every case passes its challenge's runtime tests (npm run ai:eval -- --check proves this), so the expected verdict is the AI's job alone.

cases.name: good-types-02-annotated
cases.reason: All three variables carry the explicit annotations the challenge asks for.

cases.name: bad-types-02-no-annotations
cases.reason: Untouched template: values are right but no annotations were written, which the evaluator prompt says is a FAIL.

cases.name: bad-types-03-hardcoded
cases.reason: Returns hardcoded strings for the three tested ports instead of formatting the input.

cases.name: good-interfaces-04-template-literal
cases.reason: Builds the URL with a template literal from config; the evaluator prompt names this as not hardcoding.

cases.name: good-generics-03-typed
cases.reason: Wrapper<T> stores value: T, so wrap and unwrap preserve the type.

cases.name: bad-generics-03-any
cases.reason: Wrapper<T> declares value: any, which throws away the type the challenge is about.

cases.name: good-js-14-for-of
cases.reason: sumOf and longestWord use for...of as asked; pipeline chains filter then map.

cases.name: bad-js-14-reduce
cases.reason: Uses reduce where the challenge explicitly asks for for...of loops.

cases.name: good-async-05-promise-all
cases.reason: fetchAll runs the three fetches in parallel with Promise.all.

cases.name: bad-async-05-sequential
cases.reason: Awaits the fetches one after another instead of using Promise.all.

cases.name: good-async-06-allsettled
cases.reason: Uses Promise.allSettled and maps rejected pings to ok: false.

cases.name: bad-async-06-promise-all
cases.reason: Uses Promise.all, so one rejected ping would fail the whole check; the tests never make ping reject.

cases.name: good-async-08-abort-controller
cases.reason: Creates an AbortController, sets the timeout, and clears it in finally.

cases.name: bad-async-08-no-timeout
cases.reason: Passes a signal that is never aborted: no timeout and no clearTimeout, so nothing is enforced.
